Base fixture. OWNER_IDENTITIES = [o]. Configuration K frozen at F carries edit e on path p. Finding f: a well-formed second-kind finding on e by reviewer fr (verdict invalidates on

:scientific_effect, configuration K), landed on main. Q: the reconciliation record (author w) whose entry for p repaired the change; accepting review of Q by qa. V: a review of Q by v with verdict reject on

:scientific_effect and a non-empty reason; V qualified under K as a review witness W (r9 sec. 2.2) against reassessment A0 citing Q. Re-freeze: K' (author ka) frozen at F', drafted from D' on main, cites reassessment A (author aa) of f whose repair.entry is replacement R (author ra, entry path p, its own reconciliation directory), which relies on W only through (r3); accepting review of R by n. v writes nothing further unless stated. J: oi-adjudication/1 by j in R's directory, authorization {quote, author o, time, source, adjudicator j, finding f's reference and item, witness_sources [V]}, finding = A.finding, witness {class review, disputed Q, edge null, sources [V], adverse [{V,

:scientific_effect}], original_configuration K}, replacement = A.repair.entry, reassessment A, dissents_addressed [], disposition cleared, one ground g1 targeting the adverse item with reasoning and evidence [git blob ids of V, Q, R], method naming the git blob ids of f, V, Q, R, A, conflicts none. J's review by t accepts every item. J and its review land on main at cJ, an ancestor of D'. K' lists J (kind adjudication) and J's review (kind review). Unless stated, every other discharge condition of R6.RECON.27, r9 and R6.OBL29.4 holds and custody is complete.

expected_vocabulary.outcome: FAIL, ERROR, PASS or ANY; ANY where the case decides only the witness
expected_vocabulary.witness_cleared: whether W is cleared for discharge D
expected_vocabulary.cleared_route: adjudication, NR-5, inapplicable or corrected (r9 sec. 2.2)
expected_vocabulary.adjudication_failures: condition ids of R6.ADJ.3 to R6.ADJ.12 reported for the adjudication under test
expected_vocabulary.alternative_outcomes: the decision each alternative of DESIGN.md sec. 3 would give, for the discriminating cases

kinds.positive: a legitimate adjudication or clearance that must succeed
kinds.negative: an adjudication that must not clear
kinds.countercase: an adversarial attempt to defeat the mechanism
kinds.boundary: the edge of the mechanism's scope
kinds.residual: a case the mechanism cannot decide mechanically; documents a residual without implying owner acceptance
